principle: A relationship journey is closed only when the user can understand the relationship, reach the most specific supported destination, and continue or return without losing record identity or scoped context.

journeys.touch: elected-name links and relationship controls meet 44px minimum

journeys.identity: timeline item ID plus report slug
journeys.touch: brand button and Calendar record control meet 44px minimum

journeys.identity: accountability record ID and record type
journeys.touch: relationship chip and full Civic Asset card are touch-friendly

journeys.identity: public record ID / exact source identity
journeys.touch: relationship controls and Public Record context cards are touch-friendly

journeys.to: Exact City Monitor record when linked
journeys.return: Related BetterMakati record where supplied by the owner

journeys.to: Statistics / Projects & Budget / Accountability / Civic Map
journeys.touch: profile actions and scoped controls meet 44px minimum
shared external relationship control meets 44px minimum
journeys.exception: This is intentionally one-way. BetterGov is context, not evidence for a Makati-specific fact, and BetterMakati cannot guarantee a reverse link from an external site.

boundedExceptions.reason: External ecosystem context is intentionally one-way and never treated as Makati-specific evidence.
The Calendar is a time index. Its item links back to the owning civic record instead of duplicating the full record.
Reports, Integrity tables, Public Record context cards and Civic Asset relationship cards keep richer layouts rather than being forced into the compact relationship component.
